IS 18317 : 2024 Lacquers and Decorative Finishes for Three Piece Round Open Top Metal Cans for Foods and Beverages - Specification
ICS 52.120; 87.040
ICS 52.120; 87.040
PGD 38
PGD 38
1 SCOPE
This standard describes the different types of lacquer in contact with food products, their requirements and methods of sampling and tests for internal lacquers, and also for the exterior lacquers towards protection and decoration of three piece round open top metal cans. This standard pertains to cans made of electrolytic tinplate (ETP) as per IS 1993 or electrolytic chromium/chromium-coated steel (ECCS) as per IS 12591.
2 REFERENCES
The standards listed in Annex A contain provisions which, through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision, and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent editions of these standards.
